name: Scale Welfare: fish welfare on milkfish farms in the Philippines (Ambitious Impact, 2025 idea report)
summary: Ambitious Impact's 2022 estimate for a new charity working with milkfish farmers in the Philippines to improve water quality (dissolved oxygen) on their farms, modelled like Fish Welfare Initiative's farm program. AIM reused the same sheet, unchanged, for its 2025 'East Asian fish welfare' idea (report published 2024: https://370b8129-500b-4a5d-99f2-ce6886702186.usrfiles.com/ugd/f521de_e92656e9902e4427adfa27416d6a3ca3.pdf), which Scale Welfare was founded to run. A re-implementation of AIM's spreadsheet, traced cell by cell from its welfare points per dollar of charity costs (24.4), with the 50-year discounting rebuilt from the yearly rows. Welfare points have no exchange rate to the site's scale, so a bridge of ours turns them into days of a fish's pain, weighed by Rethink Priorities' welfare range for fish.

source.title: Milkfish welfare in the Philippines (CE 2022 animal welfare report): WP model

sections.title: Staff pay below market
sections.explainer: charityevals' step, not Ambitious Impact's: with credit by share of resources on, staff's forgone pay counts as part of the cost.

sections.title: From welfare points to days of pain (ours)
sections.explainer: charityevals' bridge, not Ambitious Impact's. Ambitious Impact's welfare points (used until 2023) count one point of an animal's welfare score (−100 to +100) for one year, times its chance that the animal is sentient. We take the sentience discount out (Rethink Priorities' weights below already include it) and turn each welfare-point-year into days of disabling pain on the animal's own scale (shared figure, with a range).

sections.title: In chicken pain days
sections.explainer: charityevals' species step, the same for every animal model: days of pain for each species, weighed by how much it can suffer relative to a chicken (Rethink Priorities).

rows.label: Discount rate
rows.explainer: Ambitious Impact discounts future costs and welfare points at 0.04 a year. Linked to the shared discount rate (Your values); the evaluator view pins it to Ambitious Impact's rate.

rows.label: Staff pay as a share of program cost
rows.explainer: Default for programs where staff deliver the help themselves: about half the cost. AIM's sheet says the at-scale costs are "roughly based on 4 staff members plus additional inputs eg. water quality monitoring done by the org, potential trainings done by the org" ('WP model'!C5), so staff are most but not all of the cost. Our judgment.

rows.label: Pay gap versus comparable jobs elsewhere
rows.explainer: Health workers and field staff at nonprofits often earn somewhat less than in comparable jobs. Our judgment.

rows.label: Salary forgone by staff per dollar of cost (in-kind donation)
Share of the full cost paid in cash
rows.explainer: With credit by share of resources, staff's forgone pay counts as part of the cost, and staff get their share of the outcome. Off, this is 100%.

rows.label: Welfare points affected per dollar you give
rows.explainer: Ambitious Impact's welfare points per dollar, times the share of the full cost paid in cash.

rows.label: Welfare points per dollar you give, before the sentience discount: farmed fish
rows.explainer: Ambitious Impact's welfare points per dollar you give with its probability that milkfish are sentient (72.5%) divided back out, so the sentience discount isn't applied twice: Rethink Priorities' welfare range for fish, below, already includes it.

rows.label: Days of disabling pain spared per dollar you give: farmed fish
rows.explainer: Welfare-point-years for farmed fish times the days of disabling pain one welfare-point-year stands for (shared figure: 2.1, range 1.09 to 9.09, calibrated on Ambitious Impact's own welfare points and suffering-adjusted days for hens moved out of battery cages). These are the animals' own days, before weighing by species.

rows.label: Chicken-equivalent pain days averted per dollar you give: farmed fish
rows.explainer: The days of pain for farmed fish, weighed by how much fish can suffer relative to a chicken (Rethink Priorities; mean of carp and salmon).

rows.label: Chicken-equivalent pain days averted per dollar you give
rows.explainer: Days of disabling pain spared, all species, counted as a chicken's. The headline converts this into years of healthy life with the chicken slider and the healthy hours lost per day of disabling pain.

output.label: Chicken-equivalent pain days averted per dollar you give
